-- Relational evaluation preserves input encounter order through every operator.
import Json (..)
import Model (..)
import Binder (tree_any)
import Data.List (..)
import Data.Foldable (all, length, sum)

pub fn compare_value(a : Json, b : Json) : Int =
  match (a, b) of
    (JInt(x), JInt(y)) =>
      if x < y then
        -1
      elif x > y then
        1
      else
        0
    (JStr(x), JStr(y)) => str_cmp(x, y)
    (JBool(x), JBool(y)) =>
      if x == y then
        0
      elif x then
        1
      else
        -1
    _ => 0

pub fn evaluate(e : Expr, row : List(Json), group : List(List(Json))) : Json =
  let op = e.op
  if op == "lit" then
    e.value
  elif op == "col" then
    at(row, e.index)
  elif agg(op) then
    if op == "COUNT" && length(e.args) == 0 then
      JInt(length(group))
    else
      let vs = filter(\(v) -> not(is_null(v)), map(\(r) -> evaluate(at(e.args, 0), r, []), group))
      if op == "COUNT" then
        JInt(length(vs))
      elif length(vs) == 0 then
        JNull
      elif op == "SUM" then
        JInt(sum(map(integer, vs)))
      else
        extremum(vs, op == "MIN")
  elif op == "COALESCE" then
    coalesce(e.args, row, group)
  else
    let a = evaluate(at(e.args, 0), row, group)
    if op == "IS NULL" then
      JBool(is_null(a))
    elif op == "IS NOT NULL" then
      JBool(not(is_null(a)))
    elif op == "NOT" then
      if is_null(a) then JNull else JBool(not(truth(a)))
    else
      let b = evaluate(at(e.args, 1), row, group)
      if op == "AND" then
        if is_false(a) || is_false(b) then JBool(false) elif is_null(a) || is_null(b) then JNull else JBool(true)
      elif op == "OR" then
        if truth(a) || truth(b) then JBool(true) elif is_null(a) || is_null(b) then JNull else JBool(false)
      elif is_null(a) || is_null(b) then
        JNull
      elif op == "+" then
        JInt(integer(a) + integer(b))
      elif op == "-" then
        JInt(integer(a) - integer(b))
      elif op == "*" then
        JInt(integer(a) * integer(b))
      else
        let c = compare_value(a, b)
        JBool(
            if op == "=" then c == 0 elif op == "<>" then c /= 0 elif op == "<" then c < 0 elif op == ">" then c > 0 elif op == "<=" then c <= 0 else c >= 0,
          )

fn coalesce(args : List(Expr), row : List(Json), group : List(List(Json))) : Json =
  match args of
    Nil => JNull
    Cons(e, rest) =>
      let v = evaluate(e, row, group)
      if is_null(v) then coalesce(rest, row, group) else v

fn extremum(vs : List(Json), minimum : Bool) : Json =
  match vs of
    Nil => JNull
    Cons(v, Nil) => v
    Cons(v, rest) =>
      let b = extremum(rest, minimum)
      if (compare_value(v, b) < 0) == minimum then
        v
      else
        b

pub fn fold_constants(e : Expr) : Expr =
  let n = Expr { ..e, args = map(fold_constants, e.args) }
  if (not(agg(n.op))
      && not(elem(n.op, ["lit", "col"]))
      && all(\(a) -> a.op == "lit", n.args)) then
    Expr { ..literal(evaluate(n, [], [])), kind = n.kind }
  else
    n

fn conjuncts(e : Expr) : List(Expr) =
  if e.op == "AND" then
    append(conjuncts(at(e.args, 0)), conjuncts(at(e.args, 1)))
  else
    [e]

fn sources(e : Expr) : List(Int) =
  if e.op == "col" then
    [e.source]
  else
    flatten(map(sources, e.args))

fn combine(es : List(Expr)) : Expr =
  match es of
    Nil => literal(JBool(true))
    Cons(e, Nil) => e
    Cons(e, rest) => Expr { ..node("AND", [e, combine(rest)]), kind = "bool" }

-- Push single-source conjuncts through inner joins. With outer joins, retain
-- WHERE above the joins: filtering a nullable input can create new padded rows.
-- Folding only literal operands avoids nullable identities such as x = x.
pub fn optimize(plan : Plan) : Plan =
  let q = plan.query
  let terms = conjuncts(fold_constants(q.predicate))
  let pushable = \(e) -> let ss = sources(e) in not(elem(true, q.left_joins)) && length(plan.tables) > 1 && length(ss) > 0 && all(\(s) -> s == at(ss, 0), ss)
  let fs = map(
      \(i) -> filter(\(e) -> pushable(e) && at(sources(e), 0) == i, terms),
      range(0, length(plan.tables)),
    )
  let rem = filter(\(e) -> not(pushable(e)), terms)
  let bq = Query {
    ..q,
    predicate = combine(rem),
    select = map(\(s) -> (fold_constants(fst(s)), snd(s)), q.select),
    joins = map(fold_constants, q.joins),
    having = fold_constants(q.having)
  }
  Plan { ..plan, query = bq, filters = fs }

fn join_rows(
  left : List(List(Json)),
  right : List(List(Json)),
  on : Expr,
  outer : Bool,
  width : Int
) : List(List(Json)) =
  flatten(
      map(
          \(l) -> let matches = filter(\(r) -> truth(evaluate(on, r, [])), map(\(r) -> append(l, r), right)) in if outer && length(matches) == 0 then [append(l, replicate(width, JNull))] else matches,
          left,
        ),
    )

pub type Group = Group { key: String, rows: List(List(Json)) }

fn add_group(gs : List(Group), key : String, row : List(Json)) : List(Group) =
  match gs of
    Nil => [Group { key = key, rows = [row] }]
    Cons(g, rest) =>
      if g.key == key then
        Cons(Group { ..g, rows = append(g.rows, [row]) }, rest)
      else
        Cons(g, add_group(rest, key, row))

fn groups_for(rows : List(List(Json)), keys : List(Expr)) : List(Group) =
  var gs := []
  for row in sof(rows) do
    let key = encode(JArr(map(\(e) -> evaluate(e, row, []), keys)))
    gs := add_group(gs, key, row)
  if length(keys) == 0 && length(rows) == 0 then
    [Group { key = "[]", rows = [] }]
  else
    gs

fn project(
  q : Query,
  row : List(Json),
  group : List(List(Json))
) : List(List(Json)) =
  if truth(evaluate(q.having, row, group)) then
    [map(\(s) -> evaluate(fst(s), row, group), q.select)]
  else
    []

fn distinct_rows(
  rows : List(List(Json)),
  seen : List(String)
) : List(List(Json)) =
  match rows of
    Nil => []
    Cons(r, rest) =>
      let key = encode(JArr(r))
      if elem(key, seen) then
        distinct_rows(rest, seen)
      else
        Cons(r, distinct_rows(rest, Cons(key, seen)))

fn row_compare(
  a : List(Json),
  b : List(Json),
  order : List((Int, (Bool, Bool)))
) : Int =
  match order of
    Nil => 0
    Cons((i, (desc, first)), rest) =>
      let x = at(a, i)
      let y = at(b, i)
      let has_null = is_null(x) || is_null(y)
      let c =
        if is_null(x) && is_null(y) then 0 elif is_null(x) then (if first then -1 else 1) elif is_null(y) then (if first then 1 else -1) else compare_value(x, y)
      if c == 0 then
        row_compare(a, b, rest)
      elif desc && not(has_null) then
        -c
      else
        c

fn insert_row(
  r : List(Json),
  rows : List(List(Json)),
  order : List((Int, (Bool, Bool)))
) : List(List(Json)) =
  match rows of
    Nil => [r]
    Cons(x, rest) =>
      if row_compare(r, x, order) <= 0 then
        Cons(r, rows)
      else
        Cons(x, insert_row(r, rest, order))

fn sort_rows(
  rows : List(List(Json)),
  order : List((Int, (Bool, Bool)))
) : List(List(Json)) =
  match rows of
    Nil => []
    Cons(r, rest) => insert_row(r, sort_rows(rest, order), order)

pub fn execute(plan : Plan) : Json =
  let q = plan.query
  var scans := []
  var offset := 0
  for i in srange(0, length(plan.tables)) do
    let t = at(plan.tables, i)
    let padding = replicate(offset, JNull)
    let predicates = at(plan.filters, i)
    let rs = filter(
        \(r) -> all(\(p) -> truth(evaluate(p, append(padding, r), [])), predicates),
        t.rows,
      )
    scans := append(scans, [rs])
    offset += length(t.columns)
  var rows := at(scans, 0)
  for i in srange(0, length(q.joins)) do
    rows := join_rows(rows, at(scans, i + 1), at(q.joins, i), at(q.left_joins, i), length(at(plan.tables, i + 1).columns))
  let filtered = filter(\(r) -> truth(evaluate(q.predicate, r, [])), rows)
  let projected =
    if plan.aggregate then
      flatten(
          map(
              \(g) -> project(q, if length(g.rows) > 0 then at(g.rows, 0) else [], g.rows),
              groups_for(filtered, q.groups),
            ),
        )
    else
      flatten(map(\(r) -> project(q, r, []), filtered))
  finish(plan, projected)

pub fn finish(plan : Plan, projected : List(List(Json))) : Json =
  let q = plan.query
  let distinct =
    if q.distinct then
      distinct_rows(projected, [])
    else
      projected
  let sorted =
    if length(plan.order) > 0 then
      sort_rows(distinct, plan.order)
    else
      distinct
  let skipped = drop(q.offset, sorted)
  let final =
    if q.limit >= 0 then
      take(q.limit, skipped)
    else
      skipped
  JObj([
      ("columns", JArr(map(\(s) -> JStr(snd(s)), q.select))),
      ("rows", JArr(map(JArr, final))),
    ])

-- Typed syntax and bound logical plan. JSON is used only for wire values.
import Json (..)
import Data.String (..)
import Data.List (..)
import Data.Foldable (all, length)

pub effect Domain
  never reject(String) : Unit

pub fn demand(b : Bool, code : String) : Unit =
  if not(b) then
    reject(code)

pub fn arr(j : Json) : List(Json) =
  match j of
    JArr(xs) => xs
    _ =>
      reject("INVALID_INPUT")
      []

pub fn text(j : Json) : String =
  match j of
    JStr(s) => s
    _ =>
      reject("INVALID_INPUT")
      ""

pub fn integer(j : Json) : Int =
  match j of
    JInt(n) => n
    _ => 0

pub fn truth(j : Json) : Bool =
  match j of
    JBool(b) => b
    _ => false

pub fn getfield(j : Json, key : String) : Json =
  match j of
    JObj(xs) => lookup_field(xs, key)
    _ =>
      reject("INVALID_INPUT")
      JNull

fn lookup_field(xs : List((String, Json)), key : String) : Json =
  match xs of
    Nil =>
      reject("INVALID_INPUT")
      JNull
    Cons((k, v), rest) =>
      if k == key then
        v
      else
        lookup_field(rest, key)

pub fn fields(j : Json, names : List(String)) : Unit =
  match j of
    JObj(xs) =>
      demand(length(xs) == length(names), "INVALID_INPUT")
      demand(
          all(
              \(name) -> length(filter(\(kv) -> fst(kv) == name, xs)) == 1,
              names,
            ),
          "INVALID_INPUT",
        )
    _ => reject("INVALID_INPUT")

pub fn reserved(s : String) : Bool =
  elem(
      to_upper(s),
      split(
          32,
          "SELECT DISTINCT AS FROM INNER JOIN LEFT OUTER ON WHERE GROUP BY HAVING ORDER ASC DESC NULLS FIRST LAST LIMIT OFFSET AND OR NOT IS NULL TRUE FALSE COALESCE COUNT SUM MIN MAX",
        ),
    )

pub fn letter(c : Int) : Bool = c >= 97 && c <= 122 || c == 95

pub fn digit(c : Int) : Bool = c >= 48 && c <= 57

pub fn name_ok(s : String) : Bool =
  byte_len(s) > 0
    && letter(byte_at(s, 0))
    && all(
        \(i) -> letter(byte_at(s, i)) || digit(byte_at(s, i)),
        range(0, byte_len(s)),
      )
    && not(reserved(s))

pub fn value_type(v : Json) : String =
  match v of
    JInt(_) => "int"
    JBool(_) => "bool"
    JStr(_) => "text"
    JNull => "null"
    _ => "invalid"

pub type Column = Column {
  name: String,
  kind: String,
  qualifier: String,
  nullable: Bool,
  source: Int,
  index: Int
}

pub type Table = Table {
  name: String,
  columns: List(Column),
  rows: List(List(Json))
}

pub type Expr = Expr {
  op: String,
  value: Json,
  qualifier: String,
  name: String,
  args: List(Expr),
  kind: String,
  index: Int,
  source: Int
}

pub fn node(op : String, args : List(Expr)) : Expr =
  Expr {
    op = op,
    value = JNull,
    qualifier = "",
    name = "",
    args = args,
    kind = "",
    index = -1,
    source = -1
  }

pub fn literal(v : Json) : Expr =
  Expr { ..node("lit", []), value = v, kind = value_type(v) }

pub fn column_ref(q : String, n : String) : Expr =
  Expr { ..node("col", []), qualifier = q, name = n }

pub fn agg(op : String) : Bool = elem(op, ["COUNT", "SUM", "MIN", "MAX"])

pub fn at(xs : List(a), i : Int) : a =
  match nth(i, xs) of
    Some(x) => x
    None => at(xs, i)

pub type Query = Query {
  select: List((Expr, String)),
  sources: List((String, String)),
  joins: List(Expr),
  left_joins: List(Bool),
  predicate: Expr,
  groups: List(Expr),
  having: Expr,
  has_having: Bool,
  order: List((String, (Bool, Bool))),
  distinct: Bool,
  limit: Int,
  offset: Int
}

pub type Plan = Plan {
  query: Query,
  tables: List(Table),
  filters: List(List(Expr)),
  aggregate: Bool,
  order: List((Int, (Bool, Bool)))
}

pub fn validate_table(j : Json) : Table =
  fields(j, ["name", "columns", "rows"])
  let n = text(getfield(j, "name"))
  demand(name_ok(n), "INVALID_INPUT")
  let cs = map(validate_column, arr(getfield(j, "columns")))
  demand(length(cs) > 0, "INVALID_INPUT")
  demand(unique(map(\(c) -> c.name, cs)), "INVALID_INPUT")
  let rows = map(arr, arr(getfield(j, "rows")))
  for row in sof(rows) do
    demand(length(row) == length(cs), "INVALID_INPUT")
    for i in srange(0, length(cs)) do
      demand(value_type(at(row, i)) == at(cs, i).kind || is_null(at(row, i)) && at(cs, i).nullable, "INVALID_INPUT")
  Table { name = n, columns = cs, rows = rows }

fn validate_column(j : Json) : Column =
  fields(j, ["name", "type", "nullable"])
  let n = text(getfield(j, "name"))
  let t = text(getfield(j, "type"))
  demand(name_ok(n) && elem(t, ["int", "text", "bool"]), "INVALID_INPUT")
  match getfield(j, "nullable") of
    JBool(_) => ()
    _ => reject("INVALID_INPUT")
  Column {
    name = n,
    kind = t,
    nullable = truth(getfield(j, "nullable")),
    qualifier = "",
    source = 0,
    index = 0
  }

pub fn unique(xs : List(String)) : Bool =
  match xs of
    Nil => true
    Cons(x, rest) => not(elem(x, rest)) && unique(rest)

pub fn elem(x : a, xs : List(a)) : Bool given Eq(a) =
  match xs of
    Nil => false
    Cons(y, rest) => x == y || elem(x, rest)

pub fn is_null(v : Json) : Bool =
  match v of
    JNull => true
    _ => false

pub fn is_false(v : Json) : Bool =
  match v of
    JBool(b) => not(b)
    _ => false

defs.name: check
defs.source:
fn check(e : Expr, columns : List(Column), allow : Bool, inside : Bool) : Expr =
  if e.op == "col" then
    let matches = filter(
        \(c) -> c.name == e.name && (e.qualifier == "" || e.qualifier == c.qualifier),
        columns,
      )
    demand(length(matches) > 0, "UNKNOWN_COLUMN")
    demand(length(matches) == 1, "AMBIGUOUS_COLUMN")
    let c = at(matches, 0)
    Expr { ..e, index = c.index, source = c.source, kind = c.kind }
  elif e.op == "lit" then
    e
  else
    let isagg = agg(e.op)
    demand(not(isagg) || allow && not(inside), "INVALID_AGGREGATION")
    let args = map(\(a) -> check(a, columns, allow, inside || isagg), e.args)
    let ts = map(\(a) -> a.kind, args)
    let kind =
      if e.op == "COUNT" then
        "int"
      elif elem(e.op, ["SUM", "+", "-", "*"]) then
        demand(all(\(t) -> elem(t, ["int", "null"]), ts), "TYPE_ERROR")
        "int"
      elif elem(e.op, ["MIN", "MAX"]) then
        demand(elem(at(ts, 0), ["int", "text", "null"]), "TYPE_ERROR")
        at(ts, 0)
      elif elem(e.op, ["NOT", "AND", "OR"]) then
        demand(all(\(t) -> elem(t, ["bool", "null"]), ts), "TYPE_ERROR")
        "bool"
      elif elem(e.op, ["IS NULL", "IS NOT NULL"]) then
        "bool"
      elif e.op == "COALESCE" then
        let concrete = filter(\(t) -> t /= "null", ts)
        let common = if length(concrete) == 0 then "null" else at(concrete, 0)
        demand(all(\(t) -> t == common, concrete), "TYPE_ERROR")
        common
      else
        demand(
            (at(ts, 0) == at(ts, 1) || elem("null", ts))
              && (not(elem("bool", ts)) || elem(e.op, ["=", "<>"])),
            "TYPE_ERROR",
          )
        "bool"
    Expr { ..e, args = args, kind = kind }

defs.name: predicate
tree_any
defs.source:
fn tree_any(p : (Expr) -> Bool, e : Expr) : Bool =
  p(e) || any(\(a) -> tree_any(p, a), e.args)

defs.name: grouped
defs.source:
fn grouped(e : Expr, keys : List(Int)) : Unit =
  if not(agg(e.op)) then
    demand(e.op /= "col" || elem(e.index, keys), "INVALID_AGGREGATION")
    for a in sof(e.args) do
      grouped(a, keys)

defs.source:
fn alias_index(names : List(String), n : String, i : Int) : Int =
  match names of
    Nil =>
      reject("UNKNOWN_COLUMN")
      -1
    Cons(a, rest) =>
      if a == n then
        i
      else
        alias_index(rest, n, i + 1)

fn success(value : Json) : Json =
  JObj([("ok", JBool(true)), ("result", value)])

fn failure(code : String) : Json =
  JObj([("ok", JBool(false)), ("error", JObj([("code", JStr(code))]))])

defs.name: has_field
defs.source:
fn has_field(j : Json, key : String) : Bool =
  match j of
    JObj(xs) => length(filter(\(kv) -> fst(kv) == key, xs)) > 0
    _ => false

fn view_name(s : String) : Bool =
  byte_len(s) >= 1 && byte_len(s) <= 40
    && byte_at(s, 0) >= 97 && byte_at(s, 0) <= 122
    && all(\(i) -> let c = byte_at(s, i) in c >= 97 && c <= 122 || digit(c) || c == 45, range(0, byte_len(s)))

defs.source:
fn command_shape(c : Json) : Unit =
  let op = text(getfield(c, "op"))
  demand(elem(op, ["create", "read", "drop", "apply"]), "INVALID_COMMAND")
  if op == "apply" then
    fields(c, ["op", "changes"])
    let changes = arr(getfield(c, "changes"))
    demand(length(changes) >= 1 && length(changes) <= 200, "INVALID_COMMAND")
    for change in sof(changes) do
      validate_change(change)
  else
    fields(c, if op == "create" then ["op", "view", "sql", "optimize"] else ["op", "view"])
    demand(view_name(text(getfield(c, "view"))), "INVALID_COMMAND")
    if op == "create" then
      let ignored = text(getfield(c, "sql"))
      demand(value_type(getfield(c, "optimize")) == "bool", "INVALID_COMMAND")

fn shape_ok(c : Json) : Bool =
  handle command_shape(c) with
    never reject(_) => false
    return _ => true

defs.source:
fn compare_value(a : Json, b : Json) : Int =
  match (a, b) of
    (JInt(x), JInt(y)) =>
      if x < y then
        -1
      elif x > y then
        1
      else
        0
    (JStr(x), JStr(y)) => str_cmp(x, y)
    (JBool(x), JBool(y)) =>
      if x == y then
        0
      elif x then
        1
      else
        -1
    _ => 0

defs.name: evaluate
defs.source:
fn evaluate(e : Expr, row : List(Json), group : List(List(Json))) : Json =
  let op = e.op
  if op == "lit" then
    e.value
  elif op == "col" then
    at(row, e.index)
  elif agg(op) then
    if op == "COUNT" && length(e.args) == 0 then
      JInt(length(group))
    else
      let vs = filter(\(v) -> not(is_null(v)), map(\(r) -> evaluate(at(e.args, 0), r, []), group))
      if op == "COUNT" then
        JInt(length(vs))
      elif length(vs) == 0 then
        JNull
      elif op == "SUM" then
        JInt(sum(map(integer, vs)))
      else
        extremum(vs, op == "MIN")
  elif op == "COALESCE" then
    coalesce(e.args, row, group)
  else
    let a = evaluate(at(e.args, 0), row, group)
    if op == "IS NULL" then
      JBool(is_null(a))
    elif op == "IS NOT NULL" then
      JBool(not(is_null(a)))
    elif op == "NOT" then
      if is_null(a) then JNull else JBool(not(truth(a)))
    else
      let b = evaluate(at(e.args, 1), row, group)
      if op == "AND" then
        if is_false(a) || is_false(b) then JBool(false) elif is_null(a) || is_null(b) then JNull else JBool(true)
      elif op == "OR" then
        if truth(a) || truth(b) then JBool(true) elif is_null(a) || is_null(b) then JNull else JBool(false)
      elif is_null(a) || is_null(b) then
        JNull
      elif op == "+" then
        JInt(integer(a) + integer(b))
      elif op == "-" then
        JInt(integer(a) - integer(b))
      elif op == "*" then
        JInt(integer(a) * integer(b))
      else
        let c = compare_value(a, b)
        JBool(
            if op == "=" then c == 0 elif op == "<>" then c /= 0 elif op == "<" then c < 0 elif op == ">" then c > 0 elif op == "<=" then c <= 0 else c >= 0,
          )

defs.name: execute

defs.source:
fn finish(plan : Plan, projected : List(List(Json))) : Json =
  let q = plan.query
  let distinct =
    if q.distinct then
      distinct_rows(projected, [])
    else
      projected
  let sorted =
    if length(plan.order) > 0 then
      sort_rows(distinct, plan.order)
    else
      distinct
  let skipped = drop(q.offset, sorted)
  let final =
    if q.limit >= 0 then
      take(q.limit, skipped)
    else
      skipped
  JObj([
      ("columns", JArr(map(\(s) -> JStr(snd(s)), q.select))),
      ("rows", JArr(map(JArr, final))),
    ])

fn changed_scan(p : Plan, source : Int, old : Base, new : Base, ids : List(Int), rows : Rows) : (Rows, List(String)) =
  var out := rows
  var changed := map_empty
  for id in sof(ids) do
    match map_lookup(id, old.live) of
      Some(r) =>
        let k = position_key(r.position)
        out := map_delete(k, out)
        changed := map_insert(k, true, changed)
      None => ()
    match map_lookup(id, new.live) of
      Some(r) =>
        let k = position_key(r.position)
        if scan_row(p, source, r.row) then
          out := map_insert(k, r.row, out)
        changed := map_insert(k, true, changed)
      None => ()
  (out, map(fst, map_to_list(changed)))

      Some(r) => out := index_remove(out, slot, k, r)
      None => ()
    match map_lookup(k, new) of
      Some(r) => out := index_add(out, slot, k, r)
      None => ()

defs.name: Stage

defs.ty: forall a b c. (Incremental.Stage, Map(String, List(Json.Json), a), Map(String, List(Json.Json), b), List(String), Map(String, List(Json.Json), c), Map(String, List(Json.Json), c), List(String), Model.Expr, Bool, Int) -> (Incremental.Stage, List(String))
defs.source:
fn maintain_join(s : Stage, old_left : Rows, new_left : Rows, dl : List(String), old_right : Rows, new_right : Rows, dr : List(String), on : Expr, outer : Bool, width : Int) : (Stage, List(String)) =
  let li = update_index(s.left_index, s.left_slot, old_left, new_left, dl)
  let ri = update_index(s.right_index, s.right_slot, old_right, new_right, dr)
  var affected := map_from_list(map(\(k) -> (k, true), dl))
  -- Probe both old and new right keys, against final left rows. Changed left
  -- rows are already in affected, including deletions and key changes.
  for k in sof(dr) do
    for right in sof([old_right, new_right]) do
      match map_lookup(k, right) of
        Some(r) =>
          let candidates = lookup(bucket(r, s.right_slot), li, empty_rows())
          for pair in sof(map_to_list(candidates)) do
            affected := map_insert(fst(pair), true, affected)
        None => ()
  var children := s.children
  var out := s.rows
  var delta := map_empty
  for pair in sof(map_to_list(affected)) do
    let k = fst(pair)
    for old in sof(map_to_list(lookup(k, children, empty_rows()))) do
      out := map_delete(fst(old), out)
      delta := map_insert(fst(old), true, delta)
    children := map_delete(k, children)
    match map_lookup(k, new_left) of
      None => ()
      Some(l) =>
        var matches := empty_rows()
        let candidates = lookup(bucket(l, s.left_slot), ri, empty_rows())
        for right in sof(map_to_list(candidates)) do
          let row = append(l, snd(right))
          if truth(evaluate(on, row, [])) then
            matches := map_insert(concat(k, concat("/", fst(right))), row, matches)
        if outer && map_height(matches) == 0 then
          matches := map_insert(concat(k, concat("/", position_key(0))), append(l, replicate(width, JNull)), matches)
        for child in sof(map_to_list(matches)) do
          out := map_insert(fst(child), snd(child), out)
          delta := map_insert(fst(child), true, delta)
        children := map_insert(k, matches, children)
  (Stage { ..s, left_index = li, right_index = ri, children = children, rows = out }, map(fst, map_to_list(delta)))

defs.name: maintain_output
defs.ty: forall a. (Incremental.View, Map(String, List(Json.Json), a), List(String)) -> Incremental.View
defs.source:
fn maintain_output(v : View, joined : Rows, delta : List(String)) : View =
  let p = v.plan
  var filtered := v.filtered
  var dirty := map_empty
  var groups := v.groups
  var projected := v.projected
  for k in sof(delta) do
    match map_lookup(k, v.filtered) of
      Some(row) =>
        if p.aggregate then
          dirty := map_insert(group_key(p, row), true, dirty)
          groups := change_group(groups, p, v.aggs, k, row, -1)
        filtered := map_delete(k, filtered)
      None => ()
    if not(p.aggregate) then projected := map_delete(k, projected)
    match map_lookup(k, joined) of
      Some(row) =>
        if truth(evaluate(p.query.predicate, row, [])) then
          filtered := map_insert(k, row, filtered)
          if p.aggregate then
            dirty := map_insert(group_key(p, row), true, dirty)
            groups := change_group(groups, p, v.aggs, k, row, 1)
          else
            projected := map_insert(k, map(\(s) -> evaluate(fst(s), row, []), p.query.select), projected)
      None => ()
  if p.aggregate then
    if length(p.query.groups) == 0 then
      dirty := map_insert("[]", true, dirty)
      if not(map_member("[]", groups)) then groups := map_insert("[]", empty_group(v.aggs), groups)
    -- Remove all previous encounter keys before installing any replacements:
    -- a moved row can become the first member of a different group.
    for item in sof(map_to_list(dirty)) do
      match map_lookup(fst(item), v.groups) of
        Some(g) => projected := map_delete(fst(first_member(g)), projected)
        None => ()
    for item in sof(map_to_list(dirty)) do
      let key = fst(item)
      let g = lookup(key, groups, empty_group(v.aggs))
      if map_height(g.members) == 0 && length(p.query.groups) > 0 then
        groups := map_delete(key, groups)
      else
        for row in sof(project_group(p, g)) do
          projected := map_insert(fst(first_member(g)), row, projected)
  let result = finish(p, map(snd, map_to_list(projected)))
  View { ..v, filtered = filtered, groups = groups, projected = projected, result = result }

fn scan_string(s : String, i : Int, acc : String) : (String, Int) =
  demand(i < byte_len(s), "PARSE_ERROR")
  if byte_at(s, i) == 39 then
    if i + 1 < byte_len(s) && byte_at(s, i + 1) == 39 then
      scan_string(s, i + 2, concat(acc, "'"))
    else
      (acc, i + 1)
  else
    scan_string(s, i + 1, concat(acc, str_of_char(chr(byte_at(s, i)))))

  if i >= byte_len(s) then
    i
  else
    let c = byte_at(s, i)
    if (digit(c) || not(numbers) && (letter(c) || c >= 65 && c <= 90)) then
      scan_word(s, i + 1, numbers)
    else
      i

defs.name: lex
defs.source:
fn lex(s : String, i : Int) : List(Token) =
  if i >= byte_len(s) then
    [tok("$END")]
  else
    let c = byte_at(s, i)
    if elem(c, [32, 9, 10, 13]) then
      lex(s, i + 1)
    elif c == 39 then
      let (v, j) = scan_string(s, i + 1, "")
      Cons(Token { word = "LITERAL", value = JStr(v) }, lex(s, j))
    elif digit(c) then
      let j = scan_word(s, i, true)
      let n =
        match parse_int(slice(s, i, j)) of
          Some(v) => v
          None => 0
      Cons(Token { word = "NUMBER", value = JInt(n) }, lex(s, j))
    elif letter(c) || c >= 65 && c <= 90 then
      let j = scan_word(s, i, false)
      let w = slice(s, i, j)
      Cons(tok(if reserved(w) then to_upper(w) else w), lex(s, j))
    else
      let two = slice(s, i, min(i + 2, byte_len(s)))
      if elem(two, ["<>", "<=", ">="]) then
        Cons(tok(two), lex(s, i + 2))
      else
        demand(
            elem(c, [40, 41, 44, 46, 59, 43, 45, 42, 61, 60, 62]),
            "PARSE_ERROR",
          )
        Cons(tok(str_of_char(chr(c))), lex(s, i + 1))

fn expression(minimum : Int) : Expr =
  let t = pop()
  let w = t.word
  let e =
    if w == "NOT" then
      node(w, [expression(3)])
    elif w == "(" then
      let x = expression(1)
      expect(")")
      x
    elif w == "-" then
      literal(JInt(-natural()))
    elif elem(w, ["NUMBER", "LITERAL"]) then
      literal(t.value)
    elif elem(w, ["TRUE", "FALSE"]) then
      literal(JBool(w == "TRUE"))
    elif w == "NULL" then
      literal(JNull)
    elif w == "COALESCE" then
      expect("(")
      let args = arguments()
      demand(length(args) >= 2, "PARSE_ERROR")
      expect(")")
      node(w, args)
    elif agg(w) then
      expect("(")
      let args =
        if w == "COUNT" && accept("*") then
          []
        else
          [expression(1)]
      expect(")")
      node(w, args)
    else
      demand(name_ok(w), "PARSE_ERROR")
      if accept(".") then
        column_ref(w, name())
      else
        column_ref("", w)
  binary(e, minimum, false)

defs.name: query
defs.source:
fn query() : Query =
  expect("SELECT")
  let distinct = accept("DISTINCT")
  let sels = selections()
  expect("FROM")
  let (ss, (js, ls)) = join_sources([source()], [], [])
  let pred =
    if accept("WHERE") then
      expression(1)
    else
      literal(JBool(true))
  let groups =
    if accept("GROUP") then
      expect("BY")
      group_keys()
    else
      []
  let hh = accept("HAVING")
  let hav =
    if hh then
      expression(1)
    else
      literal(JBool(true))
  let order =
    if accept("ORDER") then
      expect("BY")
      order_keys()
    else
      []
  let lim =
    if accept("LIMIT") then
      natural()
    else
      -1
  let off =
    if lim >= 0 && accept("OFFSET") then
      natural()
    else
      0
  let ignored = accept(";")
  demand(peek() == "$END", "PARSE_ERROR")
  Query {
    select = sels,
    sources = ss,
    joins = js,
    left_joins = ls,
    predicate = pred,
    groups = groups,
    having = hav,
    has_having = hh,
    order = order,
    distinct = distinct,
    limit = lim,
    offset = off
  }
